label: The Bellman recurrence
subgoals: Define the cost-to-go of a state as the best completion from it
Add the state's own cost to the best transition plus next cost-to-go
Record the minimizing choice for the traceback

label: Solving the whole chain
subgoals: Initialize the last stage's cost-to-go with its own costs
Fill each earlier stage from the next one by the recurrence
Take the minimum at the first stage and trace back the choices

label: Counting the work
subgoals: Count the brute-force assignments as k to the s
Count the DP transitions as stages minus one times k squared
Check that the state captures everything future costs depend on
